content.question: How do decision trees partition the feature space?
options: Recursively, into smaller subsets based on significant features selected with splitting criteria.
Randomly, into two equal halves regardless of the features.
By projecting the data onto a lower-dimensional space with PCA.
By replicating minority-class samples until the classes are balanced.
content.answer: Recursively, into smaller subsets based on significant features selected with splitting criteria.
